unitTitle: Organise work, study and future plans
title: Phrases
subtitle: A2 · Unit 5: Organise work, study and future plans

steps.title: Phrases
steps.body: Notice the two common ways to talk about the future. In your notes, write one real plan with aller + infinitive and one prediction with a future simple form. Close the notes and explain both aloud.

steps.title: Say the whole block
steps.body: Learn these as blocks, exactly as you hear them. Say each one out loud. Tap the speaker to hear it.

steps.fr: Le mois prochain, je vais suivre un cours du soir.
steps.en: Next month, I am going to take an evening class.
steps.tip: Say it: luh mwah proh-SHA(N) zhuh veh sweevr uh(n) koor dü swahr

steps.fr: Je préparerai les documents ce week-end.
steps.en: I will prepare the documents this weekend.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh pray-pah-ruh-RAY lay doh-kü-MAH(N) suh week-ehnd

steps.fr: Nous allons vérifier l'horaire avant de nous inscrire.
steps.en: We are going to check the schedule before enrolling.
steps.tip: Say it: noo zah-LOH(N) vay-ree-FYAY loh-REHR ah-vah(n) duh noo za(n)-skreer

steps.fr: La formation va commencer au début de novembre.
steps.en: The course is going to start at the beginning of November.
steps.tip: Say it: lah for-mah-SYOH(N) vah koh-mah(n)-SAY oh day-BÜ duh noh-VAH(N)br

steps.fr: Je vais demander si le groupe est encore disponible.
steps.en: I am going to ask whether the group is still available.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh veh duh-mah(n)-DAY see luh groop eh ah(n)-kor dee-spoh-NEEBL

steps.fr: Tu auras une réponse par courriel lundi.
steps.en: You will get an answer by email on Monday.
steps.tip: Say it: tü oh-RAH ün ray-POHNS par koo-ree-EHL luh(n)-DEE

steps.fr: S'il y a un conflit, nous choisirons un autre horaire.
steps.en: If there is a conflict, we will choose another schedule.
steps.tip: Say it: seel ee ah uh(n) kohn-FLEE noo shwah-zee-ROH(N) uh(n) ohtr oh-REHR

steps.fr: Je ne vais pas participer mardi, mais je vais rattraper le cours.
steps.en: I am not going to take part Tuesday, but I am going to catch up on the class.
steps.tip: Say it: zhuh nuh veh pah pahr-tee-see-PAY mahr-DEE meh zhuh veh rah-trah-PAY luh koor
